THE INCIDENT HAVING HAPPENED WHERE THE WORKERS COULD SEE IT, THEY IMMEDIATELY REACTED TO DEPLOY ABSORBING PADS AROUND THE BARGE TO KEEP THE PRODUCT CLOSE TO IT, AND, ONCE EVERYTHING THAT CAN HAS BEEN PICKED UP BY THE PADS, IF THERE ARE SMALL PORTIONS OF SHEEN LEFT OVER ON THE WATER, THEY WILL USE SOAP TO GATHER UP WHAT IS LEFT AND COMPLETE THE CLEANUP. THE MUNICIPALITY OF LACOLLE AS WELL AS THE MELCC HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED.
